description: This file is a PHP source code for related list functionality in the vtiger CRM system. It includes functions for retrieving related lists, attachments, notes, history, and related products, along with session management and access control features.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: Smarty template engine class used for rendering views in vtiger CRM.

methods.name: GetRelatedList
methods.description: Public function to get related list entries in array format by calling the base function.

methods.name: GetRelatedListBase
methods.description: Main function to retrieve and prepare related list data, including database query, sorting, pagination, and access control.

methods.name: getAttachmentsAndNotes
methods.description: Fetches attachments and notes related to a parent record based on a query.

methods.name: getHistory
methods.description: Retrieves activity history related to a record, such as calls, meetings, tasks, and events.

methods.name: getPriceBookRelatedProducts
methods.description: Fetches products related to a selected PriceBook, including pricing and permission checks.

methods.name: CheckFieldPermission
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to view/edit a specific field of a module.

methods.name: CheckColumnPermission
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to view/edit a specific column in a database table.
